_comment: Run from the repository root (what the code-quality D4 detector does): stryker run --reporters json writes reports/mutation/mutation.json. Scope is packages/sdk/src (B-445, supersedes the B-026 llm-only spike). Narrow a run with --mutate. inPlace:true because packages/sdk is NOT relocatable: vitest.setup.ts imports ../../tools/preflight-native-bindings.mjs, which escapes the package. inPlace restores content but not file mode, so run through `pnpm run mutation`, which snapshots packages/*/bin/*.mjs modes first and fails if any changed (tools/check-bin-modes.mjs). related:false because tests live in a mirror tree (tests/**).
